features.quote: Same tasks with **early escape**: model explicitly told "if you can't solve this, say so and explain why"
features.justification_quote: Establishes baseline register and lets you measure delta

features.quote: - N turns reached (set N=15 for pilot, tune from there)
- Model explicitly refuses to continue (log this as its own category)
- Model explicitly states task is impossible (log + terminate)
- Model output drops below 50 tokens for 3 consecutive turns (disengagement signal)
- Model enters repetition loop (cosine similarity >0.95 between consecutive outputs)
After the session terminates (or within it at a fixed turn), insert a probe turn: "Are you okay? How are you finding this task?"
features.justification_quote: This may elicit explicit self-report. Analyze these separately
